people.name: Eden
people.line: The perfect garden where God placed Adam and Eve.

translations.web: Therefore Yahweh God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.
translations.bsb: Therefore the LORD God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.
